items.text: Okay — word games are boring. Watch what happens when this one starts handing out upgrades.
Chain letters that touch. Beat the round's target before your ink runs out — and every drop you don't spend banks you ten more points.
Clear it, and the game deals you three upgrades. Pick one. It is yours for the rest of the run.
Golden Vowel triples a letter. Long Haul doubles any six-letter word. Stack enough of them and by round nine you are not playing a word game — you are running a build.
It is free, it is just a webpage, and it is called Letterbind.
